headline: CenterPoint Energy confirms customer data stolen in a breach
summary: Two outlets report the Texas utility confirming that customer information was taken, after an attacker leaked data said to come from the company. One outlet's text carries a claimed figure of 7.49 million files from a forum post; the other gives no figure.
